name: six people live through a day in an office, and it shows in how they are

steps.note: an 18x12 office: six beds along the top, two fridges, two toilets, two computers
paused, so the only world that goes by is the one the script asks for
a whole day from opening time, sampled every world hour: 1920 ticks an hour
the needs with a prop for them are kept in hand all day: the crowd's average
ran 12-60 for hunger, 16-56 thirst, 13-55 bladder when this was written
a day of meals, goes on the computer and company leaves people content (~98)
and a night in bed rests them: the crowd's stamina ran 85 at 08:00, ~32 by
evening, and ~96 at 06:00 (86 at 08:00). It stayed under 45 all night while every
need ran at a waking pace in bed and an hour of sleep cut short was worth nothing
